sections.title: 1. Overview & Concept
sections.content: The **[C&C] PocketPig** is an interactive gamified companion HUD and avatar accessory designed specifically for Financial Submissives (FinSubs) and Dominants. It tracks 'wallet hunger', forces auditory squealing when tributes are neglected, and broadcasts live coin tributes sim-wide.

sections.title: 2. Quick Start & Pairing Mistress
sections.content:
### Step 1: Wear the PocketPig HUD
Add the HUD to any screen attachment point (Bottom Right recommended). Accept the Experience request for auto-animations.

### Step 2: Assign Owner / Mistress
Click the HUD > **Pair Mistress** > Click nearby Dominant avatar or enter their SL username. They receive an instant authorization request.

### Step 3: Set Feed Interval & Squeal Volume
Mistress configures how frequently the submissive must tribute (e.g. L$100 every 15 minutes) and sets sound volume.

sections.title: 3. Frequently Asked Questions
sections.content:
**Q: Does PocketPig award Control & Chaos XP?**
Yes! Every feed session awards +10 XP per L$100 to the submissive and +15 XP to the receiving Dominant on the sim leaderboard.

**Q: Can it be worn without a Mistress?**
Yes, in 'Self-Discipline' mode where hunger feeds into the public Sim Tribute Pool at Control & Chaos. Go get it!
